import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric (handle commas and text)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    # Fix flipper_length_mm negative values (set to NaN)
    df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 0, 'flipper_length_mm'] = np.nan
    
    # Normalize sex values (lowercase)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower()
    
    # Filter out of range body_mass_g values (2500-6500)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by sex and calculate mean body_mass_g
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
